execution.label: Execution mode
execution.sectionDesc: Execution mode comes from the image that is running. This page only shows it.
execution.worktreeHelp: This environment runs the Worktree image. Solo, workflows, and chat tests all start in this image, with no extra container boundary. Git repositories use a worktree for this launch; other folders get their own directory. Commands come from the seven coding tools, git, gh, glab, and Chromium in the image. The value comes from the current image. Switch to sandbox by deploying the slim service image plus the sandbox image.
execution.sandboxHelp: This environment runs the slim service image plus the sandbox image. Agents start in a sandbox container. The value comes from the current image and cannot be edited here. Switch to worktree by deploying the Worktree image.
execution.banner: This image includes the seven CLIs, the browser preview, and the build toolchain. It does not include dockerd, sshd, or code-server. The agent and the service share one container. Sandbox memory, recycle, and capacity belong to the sandbox deployment and are not offered here.

settings.max_concurrent_runs: Max workflows in running state. Read-only when locked by GRASP_MAX_RUNS.
settings.sandbox_memory_mb: 0 follows the gateway defaults or selected E2B template. An override must be at least 1024 MiB, within Docker/K8s resource caps, and exactly match E2B template memory. The browser, Docker and builds share this memory; exceeding it can trigger OOM. Applies to new sandboxes. Read-only when locked by GRASP_SANDBOX_MEMORY_MB.
settings.agent_idle_timeout_minutes: When the agent shows no output, CPU or disk activity for this long, the sandbox tries to resume it once and, if it stays silent, stops the turn as stuck (the node retries once in a fresh sandbox). Agents running builds, tests or long reasoning keep CPU/IO busy and are not stopped. Applies from the next turn (2–120 minutes, default 20). Read-only when locked by GRASP_CHAT_IDLE_SEC.
settings.sandbox_idle_ttl_minutes: Save and release resources after this long without tasks, queued requests or terminal activity. Applies to every sandbox; defaults to 60 minutes. The environment resumes when needed.
settings.max_sandboxes: One limit for all sandboxes, including those starting, running or waiting to release resources. Creation and resume require a free slot. Lowering the limit does not stop existing sandboxes.

capacity.note: Includes all purposes and backends. Slots are freed only after resources are released; saved environments do not use a slot.

close.busy: The Agent is working; closing interrupts the current task.
close.pushFirst: Have the Agent commit and push first
close.pushFirstHint: Sends a message asking the Agent to push its changes; close afterwards
close.pushPrompt: Please commit all current changes and push them to a remote branch, then tell me the branch name and a summary of the commits.

delete.title: Delete session
delete.body: This deletes the session and all its messages. It cannot be undone.
delete.bodyActive: This closes the sandbox, then deletes the session and all its messages. It cannot be undone.

errors.session_closed: The session is closed. Restart it first.
errors.session_error: The sandbox is unavailable. Restart the session.
errors.model_not_in_configuration: That model is not in this Agent's model configuration
errors.model_unavailable: That model is no longer available
errors.model_switch_failed: Could not switch model settings. Restored the previous model and reasoning effort.
errors.name_too_long: Repository names are at most 80 characters
errors.name_taken: A repository with this name already exists
errors.branch_invalid: Branch names cannot contain spaces, {'|'} or ,
errors.branch_invalid_repo: Branch names cannot contain spaces, {'|'} or , ({repo})
errors.repo_dir_conflict: Directory name {dir} is used by repositories {repos}. Change the directory name in repository settings.
errors.repo_dir_invalid: Directory names may only contain letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens
errors.reasoning_effort_unavailable: The selected reasoning effort is unavailable for this model. Choose another level.
errors.commit_name_invalid: The commit name cannot contain angle brackets or line breaks and must be at most 120 characters
errors.credential_invalid: The repository credential cannot be used: make sure it is not revoked and matches the address's protocol and host
errors.credential_unavailable: The credential service is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.sandbox_limit: Sandbox limit reached. Stop an idle environment first.

reference.pickerLabel: Reference a session or GitHub issue/PR
reference.unchecked: Access could not be checked at send time; the agent will read it itself

stop.hint: Save the environment and release runtime resources; resume to continue
stop.busy: Wait for the current reply and queued messages to finish before stopping
stop.title: Stop environment
stop.body: Save the environment before releasing resources and its slot. If saving fails, the original sandbox is kept. History stays available, and resume uses the latest successful recovery point.

wake.hint: The platform paused this sandbox. Click, or just send a message, to resume it

pausedStage.title: Sandbox paused
pausedStage.hint: The environment is paused, so the browser, terminal and IDE are temporarily disconnected. Resume or send a message to reconnect and continue.

stoppedBar.text: The environment is saved and stopped. Resume to continue.
stoppedBar.stopping: Saving the environment and releasing runtime resources…

projects.title: Repositories
projects.subtitle: Register Git repositories for Solo sessions. They are cloned when a session starts.
projects.emptyHint: Add a Git repository, then pick it on the home page or the Solo page to start a session with it.

delete.title: Delete repository
delete.body: Delete repository "{name}"? Running sessions are not affected; they keep the settings they started with.
delete.active: {n} running sessions still use this repository.

form.name: Name
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Optional, what this repository is for
form.commitNameInvalid: No angle brackets or line breaks; at most 120 characters
form.commitHint: Agents sign commits in this repository with this name and email. Leave empty for the sandbox default.

credential.label: Credential
credential.hint: Used to clone and push this repository. Only Git tokens or SSH keys matching the address's protocol and host are listed.
credential.noneFits: No credential matches this address. Add one first for a private repository.
credential.mismatch: The selected credential is revoked or does not match the address's protocol or host. Choose another.
credential.missing: The selected credential was deleted. Choose another.

desc.audit: Review tool calls and MCP access made by Agents in this workspace.
